item.title: Lewis and Clark County Fairgrounds fire impacts one year later
item.description: Last year, a structure at the Lewis and Clark County fairgrounds caught fire right where I’m standing. One year later, we have a better idea of the total damage done.

item.title: Powerful winds cause damage and topple trucks across Montana
item.description: Strong winds knocked down trees, damaged fences and flipped semis across north-central Montana Thursday. Gusts hit 79 mph in Great Falls and reached 104 mph at Judith Peak.

item.title: One version of proposed political spending initiative set for signature gathering, second headed to court
item.description: The organization proposing a ballot initiative intended to keep corporations from spending money in Montana elections says it’s ready to start gathering signatures for one version of its proposal.
